maria_support: FYI ticket CS-9732 — customer shows a charge for an order they cancelled. I attempted the usual refund flow but the router picked the dispute/chargeback tool instead. Need quick rollback.
router-bot: auto-routing -> selected `create_chargeback_v2` for intent 'issue_refund' (confidence 0.68). Matched aliases: ["dispute", "chargeback"].
maria_support: here's the API call I used:
```json
POST /v1/tools/invoke
{
  "tool": "refund_payment",
  "args": { "payment_id": "pay_8421301", "amount_cents": 4999 }
}
```
sam_payments: did you see a 200 from the tools API or an error? any returned tool_id?
maria_support: got 202 Accepted, router returned tool invocation id `inv_9911` and the next log shows it forwarded to `create_chargeback_v2`:
```
router: routeId=rt_21 selected_tool=create_chargeback_v2 payload={"payment_id":"pay_8421301","reason":"customer_cancelled"}
```
anya_engineering: can you paste the full proxy log (headers redacted)? need to reproduce locally. also what's the model/router version?
maria_support: router version `router-3.4.1` — full minimal repro curl below:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tool":"refund_payment","args":{"payment_id":"pay_8421301","amount_cents":4999}}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
{ "invocation_id":"inv_9911", "picked_tool":"create_chargeback_v2" }
```
kevin_escalations: that is bad — create_chargeback kicks off a dispute with the issuing bank. Legal and finance need to review before we escalate to chargeback. Stop any automated follow-ups and block `inv_9911`.
refunds_team_bot: To halt a routed chargeback, call `/admin/abort_tool_invocation` with invocation id. For now run: `POST /admin/abort_tool_invocation { "invocation_id":"inv_9911" }`.
sam_payments: @anya can we add a short-circuit: if intent contains "customer_cancelled" prefer `refund_payment` even if confidence slightly lower? Also add stricter schema checking: chargeback tool requires a `dispute_reason` enum and `bank_claims` field — router shouldn't map a generic `reason`.
anya_engineering: agree. Root cause appears to be overlapping aliases and weak schema validator in router. I'll push a hotfix to prefer explicit refund when args include `payment_id` and `amount_cents` with no `dispute_claims` object. Will also add an alert when picked_tool != requested_tool.
maria_support: thanks — I've notified the customer it's being handled and paused automation on their account. Assigned follow-up to @kevin_escalations for legal sign-off.
kevin_escalations: adding :warning: legal loop. please DM me the invocation id and ticket link.
anya_engineering: patch queued for `router-3.4.2` — will deploy canary now, monitor for any more misroutes. :eyes:
maria_support: ok closing this thread once abort confirmed.
